sentences.text: Welcome aboard Philippine Airlines flight PR 507, from Manila to Singapore.
Today's Airbus A321neo took off from Manila at 10:02 AM local time, and climbed to its cruising altitude of about 37,000 feet.
This flight covered about 2,400 kilometers in 3 hours and 3 minutes. The average flight time on this route is about 3 hours and 10 minutes.
Besides Philippine Airlines, you can fly Manila to Singapore non-stop on Singapore Airlines, Cebu Pacific and Scoot.
One-way tickets on this route usually cost about 80 to 250 U.S. dollars, or roughly 5,000 to 16,000 pesos, depending on the airline and how early you book.
Traveling to Singapore? Filipino passport holders can visit visa-free for up to 30 days.
Bring a passport valid for at least six months, proof of onward travel, and the free SG Arrival Card, filled in online within three days before you arrive.
The aircraft touched down at Singapore Changi Airport at 1:05 PM local time.
Follow us for more flights, travel tips, and Philippine aviation stories.
